newsitem.title: MEXICO: Trinity to install train plant in Durango.
newsitem.headline: Trinity to install train plant in Durango.

text.p: The U.S. firm Trinity Industries Inc in 1997 will begin installing a plant to repair and assemble railroad cars in the Mexican state of Durangeo, the state government said Monday.
Durango said in a news release that the plant would "repair railroad cars, and later, in the short term, assemble the cars."
The release did not provide the amount of investment.
Trinity has seven plants in Mexico to build railroad cars, containers, ships and barges.
Mexico's Grupo Acero del Norte, the controlling interest in Monterrey-based steel-maker Ahmsa, has signed an agreement with Trinity to transport the steel required for the operation, Durango said.
